facts.text: Caroline associates the song 'Brave' by Sara Bareilles with being courageous and fighting for what's right.

evidence.quote: "Brave" by Sara Bareilles has a lot of significance for me. It's about being courageous and fighting for what's right."

facts.text: Melanie acknowledges that the song 'Brave' by Sara Bareilles fits with Caroline's journey and determination to make a difference.

evidence.quote: That's a gorgeous song, Caroline. It really fits with your journey and your determination to make a difference.

facts.text: Melanie plays the clarinet and mentions that it has been a way for her to express herself and relax.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I play clarinet! Started when I was young and it's been great. Expression of myself and a way to relax.

facts.text: Caroline started playing acoustic guitar about five years ago as a way to express herself and escape into her emotions.

evidence.quote: I started playing acoustic guitar about five years ago; it's been a great way to express myself and escape into my emotions.
